geometry_treatment: Retain all year-specific source outlines and existing approved repairs; classify the reviewed transitions as provisional GIS maintenance.
count_treatment: Retain published PIT/HIC without population or area allocation. Resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a reporting-jurisdiction transfer.
membership_treatment: Retain existing MSA memberships and frozen numeric boundaries. Cross-MSA county-line realignments are not assumed to cancel within sites.
revisit_condition: Revisit if facility, encampment, or contemporaneous jurisdiction evidence contradicts the provisional maintenance interpretation.

annotation_defaults.treatment: Retain source geometry, existing approved repairs, published PIT/HIC and study membership; no allocation by resident population or area.
annotation_defaults.uncertainty: Population estimates assume uniform distribution over Census 2020 block land. They do not establish shelter/encampment locations, political jurisdiction changes, or PIT/HIC reporting transfers. Percentage denominators are fixed-2020 study CoC population estimates.
